name: Retainr
title: retainr.io
shortDescription: Retainr is a comprehensive client management software designed for freelancers and agencies. It integrates features like task automation, payment processing, and client onboarding into a single platform. Users can manage projects, automate workflows, and communicate with clients seamlessly. An example use case is a digital marketing agency using Retainr to streamline client interactions, manage projects, and automate invoice processing.
cons: May be complex for small teams
Potential learning curve for new users
